theme: Light theme with alternating dark intimate sections

typography.heading_font: Cormorant Garamond (serif) for main elegant headings
rules: Use delicate serif italics (.italic) for romantic subheadings or quotes.
Use Inter with tight tracking (.tracking-tight or .tracking-tighter) for tiny uppercase labels/eyebrows (.uppercase.text-xs).
Avoid large sans-serif headers. Stick to Cormorant Garamond for main section H2s (text-4xl to text-6xl).

visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards and images. Pill shapes (rounded-full) for buttons.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very soft ambient shadows for cream cards, but rely mostly on 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Airy spacing. Generous padding (p-8, p-12, py-20, py-32) to create breathing room.

component_patterns.buttons: Pill-shaped, using ink (#161514) or accent orange (#FF5B22) backgrounds for primary, or transparent with fine borders for secondary.
component_patterns.cards: Cream #E6E1D5 or Ink #161514 for alternating dark intimate sections.
component_patterns.eyebrows: Tiny uppercase, tight tracking, muted text or accent orange.
component_patterns.icons: Use lucide-react with thin stroke widths (e.g., strokeWidth={1}) for elegance.

MUST_STAY_IDENTICAL: Hero section: full-screen video/image, breadcrumb, H1, booking CTA.

About This Service.layout: Split 50/50. Left: delicate serif text, romantic phrasing, generous line-height. Right: elegant portrait image.

What We Cover.layout: Bento grid (4 groups: Session Styles, Comfort & Privacy, Styling & Preparation, Confidential Delivery). Mix of cream and dark ink cards.
What We Cover.style: Cards with rounded-2xl, 1px border. Use elegant icons or abstract fabric textures as card backgrounds.

Who Is This For.layout: Grid of 4 (Brides-to-be, Personal Milestones, Anniversary Gifts, Maternity).
Who Is This For.style: Use image-led cards or large text with delicate dividers. Alternating dark and light elements.

Why Choose Us.style: Privacy-first trust points. High contrast, cream serif text. Numbered list with large fine-line numbers.

Our Process.layout: Vertical or horizontal timeline/stepper (Consultation → Prep & Styling → Guided Session → Private Reveal).
Our Process.style: Airy spacing, fine connecting lines, delicate serif italics.

Portfolio Showcase.style: Tasteful boudoir images. Large negative space.

FAQs.style: Minimalist, fine borders (#DBD4C6) between items, no background.

About This Service.description: Woman in white long sleeve dress, soft light, elegant.

What We Cover Background.description: Close up view of white fabric, soft folds.

Who Is This For / Process.description: Tasteful silhouette or woman in black tank top on bed.

Why Choose Us / Privacy.description: Silhouette of woman under orange sky.

motion.style: Slow fades, gentle upward y-axis reveals. Nothing bouncy or fast. It should feel like a deep breath.
motion.scroll: Consider lenis for smooth scrolling if permitted by the stack.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure muted text (#8A857D) meets contrast on cream (#EEEAE1). On ink backgrounds, use cream text.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels on all images, ensuring decorative boudoir textures are marked aria-hidden='true'.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are redesigning a single Next.js page (.js extension, not .tsx) for a luxury photography service.
DO NOT alter the sections marked as 'MUST_STAY_IDENTICAL'. Wrap them or keep their JSX completely intact.
Implement the new redesigned sections ('About', 'What We Cover', 'Who Is This For', 'Why Choose Us', 'Our Process', 'Portfolio', 'FAQs') using Tailwind CSS.
Ensure 'Cormorant Garamond' is applied via a specific class (like className='font-cormorant') for headings, while Inter is applied for small labels.
Alternate background colors between cream (#EEEAE1, #E6E1D5) and dark ink (#161514) to create an intimate, rhythmic scroll experience.
Rely heavily on thin borders (border border-[#DBD4C6]) instead of box shadows to keep it elegant.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use generic centered layouts or uniform styling. Create tension with asymmetry and negative space.
Never apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
Never center align the app container in CSS.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use placeholder URLs (like placehold.co). Always use the provided media URLs.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use fully transparent backgrounds on elements that float over content (e.g. headers, dropdowns).
